description.biologydictionary: Helps you know more about minecraft entities!
config.biologydictionary.title: Biology Dictionary Configuration
config.biologydictionary.entry.screenSca: The default screens may appear too small when the GUI scale is low.
config.biologydictionary.entry.firstPers: Position of entities riding on your shoulder in first person view.
config.biologydictionary.entry.hideEntit: Hide Entity Description Widget If Not Found
Do not show the desc widget when no desc is available for the current entity.
config.biologydictionary.entry.showOnlyD: Show Only Discovered Entities by Default
Whether entity lists show only discovered entities when the game starts.
config.biologydictionary.entry.bookItemR: If false, the screen can be opened via hot key without the book item in survival mode.
config.biologydictionary.entry.bookItemO: Book Item Obtainable From Wandering Trader
If false, The book cannot be obtained in survival mode (add the recipe manually).
config.biologydictionary.entry.entityTyp: Entity type IDs that are excluded from the Biology Dictionary.
config.biologydictionary.entry.entitySpa:
Maximum seconds spent automatically analyzing spawn biome and structure information when entering a world.
If it times out, analysis stops immediately, the world opens, and a timeout warning is shown.
Set to 0 to disable automatic analysis and rely entirely on data pack data.
config.biologydictionary.entry.inheritSi: If true, baby animals will be born silent when both parents are silent.
config.biologydictionary.entry.allowStea: If true, players can steal items from other players' inventories. Default is false.
config.biologydictionary.entry.highlight:
Highlight radius for the "Highlight" skill (m); above 160 is usually of limited use:
* Distant entities may not be loaded
* Small entities may be only a few pixels
* They may also be skipped by vanilla rendering distance
config.biologydictionary.entry.telescope: Maximum range (m) for discovering entities with a spyglass.
config.biologydictionary.entry.allowOver: Allow Overview and Skills for Undiscovered Entities
If true, the overview can be accessed even if the entity is undiscovered.
config.biologydictionary.entry.discovery:
Defines how an entity is "discovered".
Always Unlocked: All discovered on start.
Vanilla Kill: Kill or be killed by the entity (uses vanilla stats).
Biology Dictionary: Detail screen / telescope / kill / killed by / interact (requires extra save data).

Enable discovery when opening the entity detail screen.
Only effective if the active strategy supports this method.

Enable discovery when highlighting an entity.
Only effective if the active strategy supports this method.

Enable discovery when observing an entity with a spyglass.
Only effective if the active strategy supports this method.

Enable discovery when interacting with an entity.
Only effective if the active strategy supports this method.

Enable discovery when killing an entity.
Only effective if the active strategy supports this method.

Enable discovery when being killed by an entity.
Only effective if the active strategy supports this method.
config.biologydictionary.entry.skillCost: Cost configuration for various skills. Please edit directly in the config file.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.biologydi: To display or modify the properties and states of mobs.
screen.biologydictionary.player_selector: Please select an online player near you.
tag_group.biologydictionary.default.desc: Preset categories provided by this mod.
widget.biologydictionary.overview.desc: View default/reference properties for this entity type
widget.biologydictionary.highlight: Highlight mobs of this type nearby
widget.biologydictionary.entity_selectio: Add the selected entity types to the blacklist. They will be hidden from the Biology Dictionary.
property_widget.biologydictionary.air.de: Target keeps losing health if oxygen is 0
property_widget.biologydictionary.moistn: Target keeps losing health if moistness is 0
property_widget.biologydictionary.effect: Includes effects created by potions, beacons, etc
property_widget.biologydictionary.food.d: Feeding food can accelerate the growth or fall in love
Holding an item makes the target to follow you
property_widget.biologydictionary.loot_t: All possible items and conditions from the loot table
Biomes and structures where this mob can naturally spawn
(Some hardcode info may not be recognized)
property_widget.biologydictionary.moveme: Usual walking speed, not running speed
property_widget.biologydictionary.leasha: Hostile mobs are usually not leashable
property_widget.biologydictionary.eat_gr: Force the sheep eat grass at once
property_widget.biologydictionary.spawn_: Whether this entity counts toward the mob spawning cap
property_widget.biologydictionary.boundi: Entities X in MC should all be equal to Z
property_widget.biologydictionary.varian: See if your zoo has every variety~
property_widget.biologydictionary.markin: Determines the horse's appearance together with the variant
property_widget.biologydictionary.schedu: Villagers do not work at night
property_widget.biologydictionary.ai.des: No AI, no movement (also defy gravity)
property_widget.biologydictionary.ai.swi:
Off: No AI; On: With AI (default)
In survival mode, disabling AI will also enable invulnerability
property_widget.biologydictionary.invuln: Players in creative mode can still hurt invulnerable mobs
Set Whether Or Not To Be Invulnerable
Includes not only chirping, but also sounds such as walking
property_widget.biologydictionary.persis: Whether the target will despawn under certain conditions
Off: Follow natural rules (default); On: Force persistence
property_widget.biologydictionary.growth: Grows into an adult when the progress is full
Lock In Baby State (For Babies Only)
Off: Keep growing (default); On: Never grow up
property_widget.biologydictionary.breedi: Cannot fall in love again immediately after breeding
Lock The Breeding Cooldown (For Adults Only)
Off: Cooldown continues (default); On: Set cooldown to infinity
property_widget.biologydictionary.in_lov: Falls in love for some time after feeding
property_widget.biologydictionary.portal: Push the target out of the portal and the cooldown will continue
Lock Or Clear The Portal Cooldown
Off: Clear cooldown; On: Set cooldown to infinity
The player who owns the target
Player not online or not in this world
Gift the pet to other players
property_widget.biologydictionary.invent:
Not all mobs have inventories
Equipment slots are sometimes counted too

Pretend to read, but sneak closer...
Don't get caught by the target's eyes!
Equipment cannot be stolen in survival mode
property_widget.biologydictionary.job_si: Villagers should get close to the block to replenish goods
Highlight the site for some time
property_widget.biologydictionary.restoc: Generally, villagers only restock 2 times a day during working hours
Ask the villager to restock immediately (may need to pay with emeralds)
property_widget.biologydictionary.bee_hi: Highlight the hive for some time
The bee will try to find another hive (may be the same one)
property_widget.biologydictionary.despaw: Have a sip of water and stay for 2 more minutes
dialog.biologydictionary.entity_blacklis: Once blacklisted, these creatures will be hidden from the Biology Dictionary and excluded from the total count. To undo, use Settings or manually edit the config file.

However, the blacklist is a server-side config; this action is only saved locally and won't take effect on the current remote server. To make it effective here, ask the server owner to update the server config.
Proceed anyway?
warn.biologydictionary.spawn_analysis_ti:
Automatic analysis of entity spawn biomes/structures timed out (%s), so the information may be incomplete.
Processed: %s/%s biomes, %s/%s structures, %s templates.
Increase config entry "%s" for complete information (slower world startup),
or set it to 0 to disable analysis and rely only on data pack data.
